title: Reshape the same data
summary: reshape changes the arrangement while preserving the number of values.
introduction: reshape changes the arrangement while preserving the number of values. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: reshape changes the arrangement while preserving the number of values.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

x = tf.constant([1, 2, 3, 4])
print(tf.reshape(x, (2, 2)).numpy().tolist())
blocks.title: Reshape the same data

blocks.text: The output is [[1, 2], [3, 4]]. Four numbers fit a two-by-two table.

blocks.text: The product of new dimension sizes must match the number of values.
